scope: Selected client fields and existing-artifact inspection. No simulations or combat-code changes.

1900.name: Crusader
1900.current_handler: Strength only; 100 - 4 * (level - 60), without a below-60 clamp.
1900.qualification: The wrapper's proc-chance field does not establish the effective enchant PPM. Healing outcome, eligibility and threat must not be inferred from the flat amount alone.

803.name: Fiery Weapon
803.qualification: The sourced amount agrees with the handler. It does not verify the inherited 6 PPM or proc masks.

1898.name: Lifestealing
1898.current_handler: Damage only, not a health-leech implementation.
1898.qualification: No current profile equips this enchant; full leech outcome and healing behavior remain separately scoped.

current_equipment.qualification: Counts are equipment slots, not assumed proc events. All 17 current tanks have one Crusader enchant; this does not quantify effective healing or DPS impact.

vendor_effects.name: Adaptive Combat Assistant
vendor_effects.qualification: Description ties the explosion to the shield expiring before its normal duration. Depletion, dispel and other early-removal semantics remain a script question.

vendor_effects.name: Defender's Grip Stabilizer
vendor_effects.location_multiplier: Description doubles the effect in Strongholds and Cities.
vendor_effects.qualification: The ordinary outside-city branch is sufficiently specified without inventing location-dependent combat behavior.

vendor_effects.name: Totem of the Storm
vendor_effects.meaning: Lightning Bolt may trigger Maelstrom Weapon with a 50% reduced chance.
vendor_effects.qualification: The dummy effect does not specify the effective spell-event probability or a PPM normalization basis.

spell_inventory.qualification: This is the saved historical inventory, not a refreshed runtime census. Its tank/selected-talent descriptions need updating; static source-ID coverage is a different check.

weapon_racial_scope.description_scope: All spells and abilities while an axe or two-handed axe is equipped.
weapon_racial_scope.community_scope: Forever Hunter wiki excludes ranged crit but includes melee/spell/pet crit.
weapon_racial_scope.current_code: AddWeaponSpecializationCrit adds MeleeCrit and SpellCrit; ranged outcome resolution also reads MeleeCrit.
weapon_racial_scope.qualification: A real source/code disagreement, not proof that generic gear crit should stop sharing. Current live scope needs a focused racial-weapon control.

failures.TestConfirmedTalentRanksMatchTheSim: Seven assertion failures compare sourced post-patch Paladin/Warrior values against generated 69893 expectations.
failures.TestTalentTreesMatchTheirProtos: Assumes contiguous wire field numbers rather than declaration order; also identifies the stale production Paladin final-tree size of 18 versus 17.
failures.TestPresetBuildsAreLegal: Two obsolete Holy Paladin exports and Elemental's old Level 60 export are illegal. The latter is not part of Elemental's current BuildPresets picker list.
failures.TestLandingPageBuildLinksNamePresets: Expects legacy build-link markup absent from the current landing page.
failures.TestSimTitleDropdownBuildsMatchLandingPa: Uses the same obsolete landing-page link contract.

legacy_fixture_probe.qualification: This small fixture probe does not claim a complete inherited-suite audit. No combat requests or benchmark results were rerun.

talent_source_reconciliation.old_conflicts: The later reversal in docs/talent-check-2026-09-17.md supersedes its earlier seven-conflict rejection. The crawl was BlizzCon-derived, not contemporaneous beta verification.

position_conflict.disposition: Current UI follows the explicit September 24 official position swap, not the older positions retained in the captured node rows.
